A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''guard''' was positioned near [[Vishtu command enclave]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Yuuzhan'tar]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. There, he backhanded a disguised [[Nom Anor]] for trying to listen to a nearby argument.
